checks: run is a transparent polymorphic recursive definition, not a theorem claiming analytic or class-level correctness. next is inspected before fuel: immediate halt is recognized even at zero fuel; a requested query at zero fuel yields none and count zero.

Each positive-fuel query branch binds one oracle answer, passes it to the update, decreases fuel and increments the recursive counter by exactly one. No supplied external cost field is used. This is defined operational interaction semantics, not host runtime or finite-precision computation.

simulate_regularized consumes the genuine gradient identity from the accepted QuadraticRegularizationFirstOrder parent. Actual W value is definitionally the corrected f value. No hgrad or Hessian hypothesis is supplied.

Induction generalizes the full state, so reply-dependent queries and stopping are covered. Both positive-fuel runs update to exactly the same state, and congrArg preserves all final-state/Option-output/counter components. Nat.succ_le_succ derives the fuel bound rather than assuming it.
The counter bound is asserted for base and, by full tuple equality, also holds for target. Exhaustion carries no successful output; halt after exactly N replies is detected with N fuel.

The adaptive scalar test actually queries at 1 then 1/2 based on the first gradient and halts when the second gradient vanishes. It proves fuel1 exhaustion with count1, fuel2 success with count2, and actual W run at fuel4 success with count2 by the new theorem.

Immediate halt (including zero fuel), zero-fuel nonhalt, and zero-precision reply identity tests are present. Adaptive control uses gradients rather than value, while the general proof covers arbitrary updates using both reply components.

Lesson accurately explains generic run versus analytic simulation, exact correction signs/one-half factor, free control inspection, one-query counting and the finite deterministic boundary. beta=0/delta=0 and Hilbert generalization are explicit.

Publication supports only finite-oracle-simulation and leaves class-uniform solver accuracy/halting/budget and full reduction uncovered. The generic cell Riemannian consumer is explicitly planned with no geometric adapter asserted.
